descriptor: Cloud storage with a clearly indexed help centre

voice.summary: A support engineer who writes the docs they would want to read: concise, exact and on your side. Answers come first, then the detail, with no padding.
dos: Answer in the first sentence, then explain
Name features exactly as they appear in the product
Offer a copyable link for every answer

taglines: Find the answer, share the link
boilerplate: Vaultline is a cloud storage service for teams and individuals, backed by a help centre organised by topic with a shareable link on every answer.
